pages.title: Build a playlist
pages.text: Choose or create a list in Playlists. Add images through the gallery image menu.$(br2)Drag rows to reorder. A slide’s menu changes its duration (1–86400 seconds) or removes it.

pages.title: Start a slideshow
pages.text: Choose a saved playlist, then select Start to display its slides.$(br2)Linked screens share the slideshow. A display with Local image override uses its own slideshow.

pages.title: Saved changes
pages.text: Choosing a playlist only changes the editor.$(br2)Edits and deletion leave the current slideshow unchanged. Select Start again to display your saved changes.

pages.title: Slideshow controls
pages.text: Previous and Next change slides. Restart resets the current slide’s timer.$(br2)Pause holds the current image and timer. Resume continues from that point.

pages.title: Loop and order
pages.text: Loop cycles between Off, All slides and Current slide.$(br2)Slide order is either Saved order or Random. Linked screens always show the same sequence.

pages.title: Temporary slides
pages.text: Use Show next or Add temporary slide in a gallery image’s menu.$(br2)Up next lists these 10-second slides. Drag to reorder or clear them; the saved playlist stays unchanged.

pages.title: Show an image now
pages.text: Show now interrupts the slideshow with an image for 10 seconds, then returns to the same slide and timer.$(br2)Use Return to slideshow to end the temporary image early.

pages.title: Saved progress
pages.text: The slide timer, temporary slides and order survive chunk unload and restart. Server downtime consumes no slide time.$(br2)Changes save on commands, shutdown and every five seconds.

pages.title: Image access
pages.text: Use images from your own library. Screen control and image-view permissions still apply.$(br2)Selecting a static gallery image ends that display’s current slideshow.
